naming: The loader reads the document with YamlDotNet's CamelCaseNamingConvention and refuses any key it does not know.

keys.description: Always repository: the file osdu-delivery.yaml (or osdu-delivery.yml) at the root of a repository, naming the code every run of its flows carries in the correlation id of its OSDU requests. A flow takes the nearest one in its folder or a folder above it, up to the folder holding .git.

The repository's code: the segment after osdu-delivery in the correlation id of every OSDU request its flows' runs send, `osdu-delivery-<code>-<operation>-<run id>`. A lower-case letter, then lower-case letters and digits, at most 16 in all and no hyphen.
